common_shapes_comparison.description: Common Shapes: UV unwrapping with the fewest valid charts (paper Table 1, Common Shapes rows). Charts must be continuous, fold- and overlap-free and within the paper's per-chart area-distortion threshold tau = 1.25 (fixed by the evaluator). Hidden test: 12 held-out meshes run through each method's unwrap.sh.

success_rate.description: % of meshes whose output keeps the input surface and has only valid charts.

avg_charts.description: Headline metric: mean per-mesh chart count; an invalid chart counts one chart per triangle, a failed mesh one chart per input triangle.

angular_distortion.description: Mean per-mesh angular score 1 - mean|cos(tangent, bitangent)| (paper Sec. 4.1); triangles of invalid charts count |cos| = 1, failed meshes 0.

area_distortion.description: Mean per-mesh worst-chart area distortion (paper Eq. 3, triangle values clipped at 10); 10 for a mesh with an invalid chart or a failed output.

common_shapes_comparison._notes: results = paper Table 1 (Common Shapes, all 24 meshes, packed atlases, the paper's own chart counting and success criterion; tau is not enforced on baselines there). The gym scores 12 held-out meshes, un-packed outputs, charts from input-surface edges with UV continuity, and enforces tau = 1.25 per chart on every method, so baseline rows are not on the gym's scale.
